card.name: Second-person words in casual web prose
card.fires_on: Responds to "you", "your", "our" and nearby small words in conversational general-web writing, often in asides like "as you'll remember" or "for those of you who". It is not tied to drug-label text.

modes.label: Reader address
modes.description: The word "you" or "your" when the writer speaks directly to the reader in an aside or question.
modes.example: Do<< you>> know . . . - Which president could

modes.label: Other small words in the phrase
modes.description: Linking words such as "who", "at", "the" or "our" inside set phrases that address or include the reader.
modes.example: For those of you<< who>> are rusty on your ecology, biomass is

card.plain: It lights up when a writer talks straight to the reader, as in "do you know" or "for those of you who".
